directAnswer: To secure your Google account, enable two-factor authentication and review your account recovery options regularly.
summary: Securing your Google account is essential to protect your personal information from unauthorized access. Follow these steps to enhance your account security.

sections.heading: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
sections.body: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security by requiring a second form of verification. This can be done via SMS, Google Authenticator, or a security key.

sections.heading: Review Account Recovery Options
sections.body: Ensure your recovery email and phone number are up to date. This helps in regaining access if you forget your password or if your account is compromised.

sections.heading: Check Security Settings
sections.body: Regularly review your security settings to monitor any suspicious activity or unauthorized devices that may have accessed your account.

steps.title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
steps.detail: Go to your Google Account settings, select 'Security', then find '2-Step Verification' and follow the prompts to set it up.

steps.title: Update Recovery Information
steps.detail: In the 'Security' section, look for 'Ways we can verify it's you' and ensure your recovery email and phone number are current.

steps.title: Review Your Devices
steps.detail: In the 'Security' section, check 'Your devices' to see all devices that are signed into your account and remove any that you do not recognize.

faqs.question: What should I do if I suspect my account has been hacked?
faqs.answer: Immediately change your password and review your account activity for any unauthorized changes. Enable two-factor authentication if you haven't already.

faqs.question: Can I use an authentication app instead of SMS for two-factor authentication?
faqs.answer: Yes, using an authentication app like Google Authenticator or Authy is recommended as it is generally more secure than SMS.

faqs.question: How often should I review my account security settings?
faqs.answer: It's advisable to review your account security settings at least every few months or after any significant changes to your account.

caveats: If you lose access to your recovery options, you may have difficulty regaining access to your account.
